Nursing staffing

Nurse staffing, unit by unit.

Registered nurses, LPNs and nursing assistants for every unit, credentialed and ready for your review, usually within days.

Request staff How we work

Nursing is where most staffing requests start, and where a gap is felt first. We place registered nurses, LPNs and nursing assistants on travel, local, per diem and permanent terms.

Med-surg, telemetry, ICU, emergency, labor and delivery, operating room, home health and long-term care: unit experience is matched to your unit, and licenses, BLS, ACLS and specialty certifications are verified during onboarding.

Every nurse arrives with a complete credential file, and one account lead stays with you from the request to the last shift.

What you can expect

  • Credentialed candidates to review, usually within days of a request
  • Licenses and certifications verified at the source
  • One account lead for the whole assignment
  • A reply to every request within one business day

Coverage in days

Every engagement type

Types of cover

One agreement, whichever mix you need

Travel contracts

Experienced clinicians for eight to twenty-six weeks, for seasonal peaks and long vacancies.

Local contracts

Clinicians who live within commuting distance, on a set schedule for a set term.

Per diem

Shift-by-shift cover for call-outs, census swings and weekends.

Permanent hires

Search and selection for the roles you want to keep, with one fee on a successful hire.

How we work

From request to first shift

Share the need

Roles, headcount, dates and must-haves. A minute on the form, or a call if you prefer.

Review the shortlist

Mutex Match ranks the pool. A recruiter vets it and sends credentialed profiles.

Interview and confirm

Speak with the clinicians you like. We lock in the offer, the start date and every compliance item.

Stay covered

One lead for extensions, replacements and reporting, for as long as the assignment runs.
